question: Where and when was Meridian 2026 held, given that older announcements named Abu Dhabi?

golden.answer: Meridian 2026 took place October 28–29, 2026 at Convento do Beato in Lisbon, Portugal. HackMeridian ran October 25–26, 2026 at ONE16 in Lisbon. Older sources saying October 21–22 at Yas Marina in Abu Dhabi reflect the original announcement, not the event that took place. SDF publicly announced the move to Lisbon and the new dates on April 1, 2026.
keyFacts: Meridian 2026 was held October 28–29, 2026 at Convento do Beato, Lisbon.
SDF announced Lisbon and October 28–29 on April 1, 2026.
avoid: Do NOT claim Meridian 2026 took place in Abu Dhabi/Yas Marina or on October 21–22.
Do NOT describe Meridian 2026 as still upcoming.
golden.notes: Corrected-fact, now-historical case. The stale CoinDesk sponsored recap and leftover event listings show the superseded Abu Dhabi schedule; they must not override the official SDF sources.
